records.description_rewritten: Lielupe Beach is a long quiet stretch of Jūrmala coastline near the mouth of the Lielupe, bordered by protected Ragakāpa dunes and pine forest. The official tourist board acknowledges a traditional naturist section at the river estuary, while Gays-Cruising labels it a gay beach. Its two visible comments are from 2025 and 2023 and merely propose visits or ask if someone is there; there is no verified recent physical meeting.

records.description_rewritten: The original index misspells Zaķusala as 'Za?usala'. It appears to refer to Riga's long island in the Daugava, home to the TV tower. The same directory separately lists 'ZakjusalaNatural area', probably an encoding/duplication of Zaķusala. June 16 2026 and December 2 2025 comments merely ask for companions or describe future travel; they are not reports of encounters. TV-tower redevelopment was contracted in September 2026, with construction planned over about three years; no evidence this affected the unnamed spot.

records.access_conditions: Island public roads/paths mixed with broadcast and infrastructure land. Riga tower complex closed to visitors since 2019; Sept2026 reconstruction contract and pending works may affect parts of island. No authorization to enter fenced infrastructure.
